rows.text: "Alright, [Trailblazer], let's keep going... Where were we? Ah! The creeping Swarm devoured the cosmos, and even threatened the Voracity... Then, the confrontation between Oroboros and Tayzzyronth lasted for several Amber Eras!"
rows.speaker: Oroboros

rows.text: "THEIR flames were magnificent beyond compare, THEIR giant maw devoured all existences. Oh, innumerable believers, giant beasts, lifeforms, that never knew their existences were ended by Aeons' battle. How weak and pitiful, for the outcome was already ordained, but they still had to live out their lives in earnest!"
rows.speaker: Oroboros

rows.text: "The appetite of organic creatures... what is its nature?" Screwllum inquires, "I have only been in the company of void song whales and butterflies, and have never researched the lifeform of Aeons. THEIR devouring is a mystery."
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: It is "to eat when one is hungry."
It is "Man's greatest desire."

"Tsk... a grand mystery of the Aeons' lives! Isn't this what Ruan Mei cares about most? In my language, it's when your stomach's going 'Grrr.' In Screwllum... what exactly do you guys eat? Anyway, it's when a Screwllum tummy goes 'Whrrr.'" Herta clears her throat, "Let us continue. I'm not done talking."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "After that, at last, the Order's Ena made THEIR appearance. THEIR visage was divine, THEIR voice sublime."
rows.speaker: Ena

rows.text: "At the same time, Order and Preservation's Paths crossed — their lights that blessed life intertwined."
rows.speaker: Qlipoth

rows.text: "Right here." Herta pauses," The second point of suspicion: Oroboros and Ena vanished in the middle of this tale! Completely, silently, as if there was another story progressing along in the shadows underneath the main stage... Or perhaps we left something out in our simulation. In any case, highly suspicious. Okay, then... What happened next? How does the story reach its climax? How did these gods join the clash of the gods in the same Amber Era? [Trailblazer], we shall continue on the third plane."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Continue." Ruan Mei says, "Everything must have an end."
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei

rows.text: Finish it up.

"Give me a moment, I'm going to start! Aha of the Elation! This one certainly went ham on THEIR antics! Anyway, THEY were the one who got everyone riled up! But did THEY truly care about any of this?"
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: "THEY did? THEY didn't? Who knows? Alas, a pity on the efforts of those generations of people on the gondola. They thought they could help the Gods... All I see is the futility of mortal acts! Then again, people work in vain, yet revel in their efforts. What of it, then?"
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: "Aha's always been this way. We should assign a 'threat meter' for THEM next time to reduce the simulated Aha's hostility. That'll stop THEM from frightening everyone all the time. Hmm... let's move on."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: (Ignore Aha.)

"The revered light of Xipe the Harmony shone like a rainbow, and the masses clamored in desire of THEIR blessing. THEY proclaimed harmonious joy, and united all wills as one. The Family's songs spread to all corners of the world, and THEIR understanding, support and synergy for the will of all creatures was beyond imagination. Or perhaps, THEY were already above all else on this front, ascending to a plane beyond mortal minds. The ever-expanding Harmony was truly desirous. Cosmic stars encircled THEM like crushed diamonds, adorning THEIR body, and civilization became a rainbow to be molded in THEIR palm."
rows.speaker: Xipe

rows.text: "Yes. The Harmony's radiance then reveals itself," Ruan Mei's voice suddenly rings out. "Interesting enough, the phenomenon of Equilibrium appears to have always been present amidst signs of Elation and Harmony. We did not manage to deduce the Equilibrium, but THEY were present throughout everything, creating subtle traces evident when the scales of balance tip — THEIR decisions are not to be questioned."
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei

rows.text: "That's right, an ancient fellow!" Herta threw up her hands, "It's just that I don't know when I'll have the honor of seeing THEIR true face. The end of the data storage approaches — congratulations are in order, but I still feel like I've forgotten something... [Trailblazer], have we left out anything?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I also wish to join!
Can I not be a part of this?
Nice one, you remembered correctly — Akivili! You are also one of the actors in this piece.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You hear a voice from the top of your head... as if it is scratching your head. It asks you with eager concern: Are you still insisting on not being involved in this?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: In that vast desert, a robe is lifted by a sweeping wind, THEIR figure faintly visible. You have a vague sense of being one with THEM, or perhaps it is just your delusion... THEIR light of Trailblaze shines at the moment the divine fell...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: And so these stars in the cosmos, scintillating, shimmering, then died out... The picture before you turns to black. Maybe in a corner known to none, there are more, many more...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Suddenly, the Sand King's simulated image lights up before you. Oh, almost forgot to mention: At a certain point in the ancient Amber Era - that was truly an uneventful time - with the coordinated efforts of the Aeons of Equilibrium, Preservation, Trailblaze, Elation, and Harmony, Tayzzyronth the Aeon of Propagation fell across the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Correction: It's SEEMINGLY! Who knows what the Simulated Universe's deduction would've missed?" Herta says mockingly. "I hope Aha didn't get the same ball as the one you have in the end. Okay [Trailblazer], the storage is complete. Get ready to move out."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: It's over already?

"Pay no mind to those pretentious rituals. However, it is true that an end must come." Herta suddenly pulls a petal off the flower on her head," And the last, as well as the most important point of suspicion. If Tayzzyronth did indeed fall according to all observations and evidence, why are there still endless Swarm offsprings roaming around the universe? What exactly is the root of the Path of Propagation... If we can figure this out, I'm sure everything will make sense. But we have a long way to go to find the answer to this question."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "More and more hard-to-solve mysteries! But that's the allure in researching Aeons, is it not?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: All right, it's over. Not bad, you even crashed the expansion terminal.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: We gained plenty in this experiment. It's all in disarray, so Screwllum and I will organize all these proper. Research will be adjourned for now.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You're asking if this is over? I'm not sure, who knows if these Fragments were affected by Enigmata? The Aeons are not so easy to understand. Slow and steady does it.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: If there's anything you're curious about, you can also keep it running — there are plenty of undiscovered pockets to be unearthed.
rows.speaker: Herta
